description: Starts or resumes the analysis with the company record, the attachments and the tender. Call it only when the user asks; follow it with get_participation. Returns 202 after it accepts and keeps the request, and 200 when it reuses a finished analysis. It uses the profile and the attachments of this owner. Interrupted requests can resume; failures tell the reason and the next action. An explicit POST resumes a pause. Up to 2 thousand facts and 100 tenders per company, subject to the available capacity and budget. Follow-up only by GET. The analysis is a triage with evidence, not a final qualification decision or an external legal opinion.

cnpj.description: CNPJ with 14 characters (digits or alphanumeric) linked to the owner.
